objective: Full-area vertical swipe on video and lower post details, plus bounded flying reaction animation in fullscreen Wall videos.
deployment: DEV source only; release requires exact-head CI, ad/nav/media gate and same-runtime staging verification.
chosenApproach: Gesture-handler Pan attached to existing tap layer and metadata; gestures page existing FlatList. Bounded UI-only native-driver emoji bursts on own reaction.
preserveBehaviors: tap play/pause, reaction picker, comments, share, signed URL and Android player handoff
Google IMA and Reels ads, first-view banners, companion placement
Connect, navigation, auth, no native dependency or database changes

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Fullscreen JS gesture handling uses existing native gesture module and must preserve Android runtime and playback integration.
preservedBehaviors: Unchanged Android native dependencies, signed video, application boot and media lifecycle

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Change Wall video touch surfaces and local reaction rendering without changing playback or monetization behavior.
preservedBehaviors: Existing fullscreen player handoff, poster, retry and bounded signed-media access

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Fullscreen gestures page the Wall viewer's virtual list and must retain authenticated navigation and close/back actions.
preservedBehaviors: Existing Wall route, modal back/close, session guard and standard reaction/comment/share taps

productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main source commit 0ee57887c991d23472cdf1f9b849bce945792910 and integrated Nov17 DEV video handoff source 2f0f684e068b794a552c33cf53cde0138907d294 were inspected. This does not verify installed Android production/staging OTA, exact runtime, network performance or ad fill; no live release authorized.
selectionRationale: A child vertical Pan recognizer on the existing tap surface handles drags without making an extra screen-wide touch layer that would block close, reactions, IMA ads or navigation. A separate footer pan and pointer-event pass-through cover the metadata obstruction. No native dependency, backend load or new player.
acceptanceChecks: Swipe up/down from the top, center, video play/pause area and over the lower post details to adjacent video with one page per deliberate swipe.
Short, diagonal, horizontal and normal tap gestures must not navigate; play/pause, reaction picker, comment, share and close remain responsive.
A genuine new reaction creates three transient flying emojis, maximum four bursts, with native-driver animation and no extra network calls.
Native in-stream IMA and Reels ads keep their original click targets, load events, first-view ad behavior and prefetch contract.
Run exact-head TypeScript, focused tests, AdMob/nav protected gate, native Android Hermes and staging runtime verification before OTA.
alternativeApproaches: Wrap the entire modal with a transparent PanResponder (rejected: could intercept sponsored ad clicks, close and gesture buttons).
Disable the video tap layer completely (rejected: breaks play/pause and first-frame interaction).
Download or pre-decode videos to change the swipe behavior (rejected: unrelated, heavier on weak networks).
